tool.help:
Stitches together multiple VTU time series archives from an IC chain run into a single continuous time series for ParaView.
**Inputs**
Add one VTU archive per segment of the IC chain, in chronological order. Each archive should be the output of the *ParaFEM to VTU (Transient)* tool applied to one solver segment.
**Time continuity**
Timestamps from each segment are offset by the cumulative end time of all preceding segments, producing a seamless timeline. The final state of each segment is used as the initial condition for the next — the VTU outputs themselves do not overlap, so no frames are dropped.
**Outputs**
A .tar.gz containing:
- ``stitched.pvd`` — open this in ParaView to view the full time series - ``stitched_NNNNNN.vtu`` — one file per timestep across all segments
